title: Minecraft Stracciatella[SERVER]
body:
[;) Server version for Minecraft Stracciatella]
This is just the Server pack, for when you want to host a M.S. Server for you and your friends only and don't want to join the official server from StudioCreations. 

The pack itself is about exploration, art and making stories and friends, and creating a bunch of really pretty pictures on the way there. You shouldn't play it single player, I mean, of course you can, but it's sooooo much more fun with other people. Don't use this if you want to join a server; use [insert link to the client side pack]. 

_[I have a kofi, if you want to support me, that'd be super duper kind, but idrc I'm making this for fun :D]_
